scripts.build:android:release: pnpm --filter fabricassist-app exec expo prebuild --platform android --clean && cd apps/client/android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.build:ios:release: pnpm --filter fabricassist-app exec expo prebuild --platform ios --clean && cd apps/client/ios && xcodebuild -workspace FabricAssist.xcworkspace -scheme FabricAssist -configuration Release archive
scripts.build:web: pnpm --filter fabricassist-app exec expo export --platform web
